title: Kaderbehoefte bij sportverenigingen 1975
contributors: Instituut voor toegepaste sociologie, ITS * Nijmegen
descriptions: For sports clubs: questions on characteristics of club, members in general and sports activities / details on club functioning / shortage / expertise / management and organization / finances and subscription / amount of work / problems / recruitment / privileges / drop-out / training accommodation.
